import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int Maxn = (1 << 19) | 5;
    static int n, k, p, maxi;
    static int[] ct = new int[Maxn];
    static int[] f = new int[Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp1 = new int[20][Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp2 = new int[20][Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp3 = new int[20][Maxn];
    static long pp;
    static long[][] t = new long[20][Maxn];
    static long[] fac = new long[Maxn];
    static long[] inv = new long[Maxn];

    static long fast_pow(long x, long y) {
        long ans = 1, now = x;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) ans = (ans * now) % p;
            now = (now * now) % p;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static void init() {
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxi; i++)
            fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % p;
        inv[maxi] = fast_pow(fac[maxi], p - 2);
        for (int i = maxi - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p;
    }

    static int lower(int x) {
        int tmp = 1;
        while (tmp < x) tmp <<= 1;
        return tmp;
    }

    static void FWT(int[] now, int len, boolean type) {
        long[] T = new long[len];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) T[i] = now[i];
        if (type) {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j += (i << 1)) {
                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        T[i + k] -= T[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j += (i << 1)) {
                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        T[i + k] += T[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            now[i] = (int) (T[i] % p);
            if (now[i] < 0) now[i] += p;
        }
    }

    static void __a(long[] x) {
        if (x[0] >= pp) x[0] -= pp;
    }

    static void multi() {
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= maxi; i++) {
                tmp1[j][i] = 0;
                t[j][i] = 0;
            }

        for (int j = 0; j <= maxi; j++) {

        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++) {
            FWT(tmp1[j], maxi + 1, false);
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {

                }
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                tmp3[q][s] = (int) (t[q][s] % p);
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++) {
            FWT(tmp3[j], maxi + 1, true);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= maxi; j++) {
            f[j] = tmp3[ct[j]][j];
        }
    }

    static void multi2() {
        long[][] tmp = new long[20][Maxn];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                t[i][s] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int l = 0; l + q <= 19; l++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                    long val = 1L * tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s];
                    __a(t[q + l][s] += val);
                }

        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                tmp[q][s] = t[q][s] % p;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            FWT(tmp[i], maxi + 1, false);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                tmp2[i][s] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxi; i++) {

        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();
